expectations.text: Emits a single Kotlin file: a class implementing KensaTest (and WithKotest), no invented @ExtendWith extension name
The Setup-phase ref becomes given(...) and the Steps-phase ref becomes whenever(...), in phase order
Each ref becomes a private function returning Action<GivensContext> / Action<ActionContext> whose body is TODO(...), with the ref id, group and step name recorded in a comment
No ReplaySteps Kotlin val name is invented — the file only carries step ids
A then/thenEventually placeholder is derived from the scenario's expect text, with collector and matcher as separate typed TODO functions
seeAlso and tags are carried as @Notes / @Tag; the app: tag is dropped
The emitted file compiles (every TODO sits in a function or property with a declared type)
Test body is prose only: no assignments, no inline lambdas, no duration literals
